title: Browse Product Catalog
description: Verify that users can browse the product catalog and filter products by category correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the product catalog page.
Apply filters by different product categories.
Check that the product list updates correctly to show only products from the selected category.
Verify that product names, images, and prices are displayed correctly.

title: View Product Details
description: Verify that navigating to a product’s detail page shows accurate information including pricing and warranty.

steps.description: From the product catalog, select a product.
Verify detailed product information is displayed including price, warranty, and description.
Verify that the Add to Cart button is present and clickable.

title: Add and Remove Items from Shopping Cart
description: Verify that items can be added to and removed from the shopping cart and subtotal updates correctly.

steps.description: Add multiple products with varying quantities to the shopping cart.
Verify that cart updates with correct product names, quantities, and prices.
Verify the subtotal calculation is correct based on items and quantities.
Remove an item from the cart.
Verify the cart updates accordingly and subtotal recalculates.

title: Guest Checkout with Valid Email
description: Verify that guest checkout works with a valid email without requiring account registration.

steps.description: Add product(s) to the shopping cart.
Proceed to checkout and select Guest Checkout option.
Enter a valid email address.
Submit the guest checkout request.
Verify that the guest session is created or linked and order proceeds to payment instructions.

title: Guest Checkout with Missing Email
description: Verify that guest checkout fails when no email is provided.

steps.description: Add product(s) to the shopping cart.
Proceed to checkout and select Guest Checkout option.
Leave email field empty.
Submit the guest checkout request.
Verify that the system returns validation error indicating that email is required.

title: User Signup with Valid Information
description: Verify registered users can sign up with valid credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the user signup page.
Enter valid user details including email and password.
Submit the signup form.
Verify that user account is created and user is redirected to login or dashboard.

title: User Login with Valid Credentials
description: Verify registered users can login successfully with correct credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input correct registered email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify user is logged in and redirected to their dashboard or home page.

title: User Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify user login fails with invalid credentials and appropriate error messages are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input incorrect email or password.
Click the login button.
Verify the login attempt is rejected with relevant error message.

title: Password Reset Flow
description: Verify that users can request password reset and reset password successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the forgot password page.
Enter registered email address.
Submit password reset request.
Verify that the system sends reset instructions or token.
Access reset-password page with valid token.
Enter a new password and confirm.
Submit new password.
Verify that password is successfully updated and user can login with the new password.

title: My Orders View for Registered User
description: Verify that logged-in users can view their order history with accurate statuses and payment verification.

steps.description: Login as a registered user with orders.
Navigate to 'My Orders' page.
Verify list of all orders is displayed with correct order statuses and payment verification information.

title: Upload Payment Proof for an Order
description: Verify that users can upload payment proof screenshots linked to their orders successfully.

steps.description: Login as registered user or proceed as guest with an order requiring payment proof upload.
Navigate to the upload payment proof page for that order.
Upload a valid payment proof image file.
Submit the payment proof upload.
Verify the upload is successful and a confirmation message is shown.

title: Admin Payment Proof Verification
description: Verify that the admin dashboard allows reviewing, verifying, or rejecting payment proofs with status updates.

steps.description: Login to the admin dashboard.
Access the list of new payment proof submissions.
Review an uploaded payment proof.
Verify and approve the payment proof or reject with comments.
Verify that the order status updates accordingly and notification is sent to the customer.

title: Wishlist Functionality
description: Verify that users can add products to wishlist, view, and remove them correctly.

steps.description: Login as registered user.
Navigate to a product and add it to wishlist.
Verify the product appears in the wishlist page.
Remove the product from the wishlist.
Verify the product is removed from the wishlist list.

title: Multi-language Toggle
description: Verify that toggling between English and Bengali locales changes the interface text accordingly.

steps.description: From any page, select the language toggle control.
Switch the language to Bengali.
Verify that all interface text updates to Bengali accurately.
Switch the language back to English.
Verify the interface text changes back to English.

title: Contact Form Submission Success
description: Verify that users can submit the contact form with all required fields and receive success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to the contact form page.
Fill in name, email, subject, and message fields with valid data.
Submit the contact form.
Verify that a success message confirming message sent is displayed.

title: Contact Form Validation Error
description: Verify that submitting the contact form with missing required fields returns appropriate validation errors.

steps.description: Navigate to the contact form page.
Submit the form without filling any fields.
Verify error messages appear indicating all required fields must be filled.

title: Payment Workflow Using Local Mobile Banking
description: Verify the complete order payment workflow via local mobile payment methods (bKash, Nagad, Rocket).

steps.description: Add items to the shopping cart and proceed to checkout.
Select a local mobile payment method.
Complete the payment following the instructions.
Upload payment proof if required.
Verify that the payment transitions order to pending verification and updates on payment verification.

title: Mobile and Desktop Responsive UI
description: Verify that all main pages (homepage, product listing, checkout, user pages) display correctly on various screen sizes.

steps.description: Access the website on desktop resolution.
Verify layout and elements are displayed correctly without overlap or truncation.
Access the website on mobile resolution.
Verify the layout adapts correctly with responsive navigation, readable text, and accessible controls.

title: API Contact Form Endpoint Validation
description: Verify the API endpoint for contact form submission returns proper status codes and error messages.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/contact with all required fields correctly filled.
Verify response status 200 and success message.
Send POST request to /api/contact with missing required fields.
Verify response status 400 with appropriate error details.

title: API Guest Checkout Endpoint Validation
description: Verify the guest checkout API endpoint creates or links guest users appropriately and handles errors.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/guest-checkout with a valid email.
Verify response status 200 and confirmation of guest user creation or linking.
Send POST request to /api/guest-checkout with missing email parameter.
Verify response status 400 with error indicating email is required.
